name: Find The Penguins
desc:
🐧 Welcome to Find The Penguins! Search through the map and collect cute penguins!

Update (may 5th):
-Added 20 penguins
-Added the bunker biome

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden penguins
🏃 Use sprint to complete obbies easier
🏆 Find all penguins to win!

Some penguins are very well hidden. Find penguins with friends and meet new friends along the way!

❄️ 93 Penguins
🐟 5 Unique areas

If you want to suggest NEW penguins, post a message on the FindSquad group wall.
